sn42.3:1.1: atha kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.3:1.2: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ yodhājīvānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.3:1.3: yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.3:1.5: alaṃ gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ, mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.3:1.7: tatiyampi kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.3:1.8: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ yodhājīvānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.3:1.9: “yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.3:2.1: addhā kho tyāhaṃ gāmaṇi na labhāmi:
sn42.3:2.2: alaṃ gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ, mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.3:2.4: yo so gāmaṇi yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ pubbe hīnaṃ dukkaṭaṃ duppaṇihitaṃ:
sn42.3:2.5: “ime sattā haññantu vā bajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā vā ahesuṃ iti vāti.
sn42.3:2.6: tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti,
sn42.3:2.7: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjito nāma nirayo tatthuppajjati.
sn42.3:2.8: sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti:
sn42.3:2.9: “yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatī”ti, sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
sn42.3:2.10: micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāhaṃ gāmaṇi purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi
sn42.3:3.1: evaṃ vutte yodhājīvo gāmaṇi parodi, assūni pavattesi.
sn42.3:3.3: alaṃ gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ, mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
sn42.3:3.4: nāhaṃ bhante etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha,
sn42.3:3.5: apicāhaṃ bhante pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi yodhājīvehi dīgharattaṃ nikato vañcito paraddho,
sn42.3:3.6: “yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatī”ti.
